High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for Imperial Squad Leader, a fan re-set (not a Players Committee or Decipher publication) with the Decipher errata text of [[Imperial Squad Leader (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Imperial Squad Leader _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IdT9JsPUVvHOow_8h47QMc0u-FROzdoU/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Imperial Squad Leader _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,760 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b4b6ecc1ed6ff759c6a1b2c46c41bb00158c1fb4e51e47bcb7e5e5bfb960008b</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)”; it is not shown on the Decipher Errata or Players Committee version pages.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
